title: The evolution and application of RNA-focused small molecule libraries
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, 6,510-527
DOI: 10.1039/D4CB00272E, Review Article
Open Access

Amirhossein Taghavi, Noah A. Springer, Patrick R. A. Zanon, Yanjun Li, Chenglong Li, Jessica L. Childs-Disney, Matthew D. Disney
Hits identified from screening diverse compound libraries against RNA targets can be used to inform design of RNA-focused libraries via computational techniques to calculate chemical similarity and physicochemical properties.
